q: The pyqsp PolySign.generate(chebyshev_basis=True) code path throws UnboundLocalError('scale') in current releases; how many downstream QSVT replication attempts silently produce garbage or crash when they hit this exact code path?
basis: During this replication we discovered that pyqsp's canonical sign-polynomial generator is broken in the Chebyshev-basis path; the working code required bypassing PolySign entirely and building the erf-interpolant manually via PolyTaylorSeries. This is a live bug in a widely-used QSP reference implementation.
next_steps: File a minimal-reproducer issue on the pyqsp GitHub. Cross-bisect pyqsp release history to identify when the bug was introduced. Publish a 'QSP smoke test' harness that fails loudly when common convention-mismatch or API-breakage patterns are hit.

q: The Wx-convention QSP signal operator (with off-diagonal i-factors) deposits an odd-degree real target polynomial in Im[U[0,0]], not Re[U[0,0]]; how many published QSVT tutorials, and possibly the paper under replication itself, adopt a convention where 'Re[U[0,0]] = P(x)' is stated even when the specific circuit realises it as the imaginary part?
basis: We wasted ~30% of the replication budget on a real-vs-imaginary channel bug: our QSVT circuit exactly matched pyqsp's own gen_unitary, but the polynomial appeared in Im[U[0,0]] rather than Re[U[0,0]] as commonly stated. Empirical verification against pyqsp's SymmetricQSPProtocol.gen_unitary was needed to nail this down.
next_steps: Systematic audit of QSVT expository papers (Martyn-Rossi-Tan-Chuang 2021, Gilyen et al. 2019, and Low-Su 2024) for the exact channel-of-realisation convention. Publish a one-page 'QSP convention cheat sheet' cross-referencing every signal-operator/measurement-basis pair to which entry of U carries the target polynomial in its real vs. imaginary part.

q: How does QEVT degrade empirically as the basis condition number kappa_S of the Jordan form grows on controlled families of non-normal test matrices (Jordan blocks perturbed by epsilon, Grcar / Kahan pseudospectra, transcorrelated quantum-chemistry Hamiltonians)?
basis: The paper's QEVT complexity is O(kappa_S * n / eps ...) but assumes kappa_S is moderate. We replicated only the Hermitian case (kappa_S = 1), leaving the entire non-normal regime — the paper's actual novel contribution — untested. A phase-diagram-style scan of QEVT accuracy vs. kappa_S at fixed n is the natural next experiment.
next_steps: Build a small non-Hermitian block-encoding harness (classical simulation, N up to ~16). Sweep a family of matrices with tunable kappa_S in [1, 10^6]. Measure eigenvalue-transformation error empirically vs. the paper's predicted scaling and identify any tacit constant-factor assumptions that dominate at practical kappa_S.

q: How does pyqsp's sym_qsp Newton phase-factor solver scale to production degrees (~1e3 to 1e4) required for the paper's ODE-solver application at tight eps, and where does it break vs. QSPPACK or pennylane's qml.qsvt?
basis: We observed 5-8 iterations to residual <1e-12 for degrees up to 41. The paper's asymptotic advantages only manifest at much higher degrees for realistic eps and t. It is unclear whether sym_qsp remains numerically stable at those degrees or whether extended-precision / preconditioned variants (Ying-Kunis, Chao-Ni) become mandatory.
next_steps: Head-to-head benchmark of sym_qsp / QSPPACK / pennylane on a fixed erf-target at degrees 100, 300, 1000, 3000. Track iteration count, wall time, final phase-set L_infty error vs. an mpmath ground-truth. Publish as a table so users can pick the right solver for their target.

q: Can we build a small (2-3 qubit) explicit worked example of the paper's central Chebyshev-history-state-generation subroutine (matrix generating function -> block encoding of superposition over T_j(H)|psi>) for a toy H = sigma_x or 4x4 shift matrix, and verify that the resulting circuit reproduces T_j(H)|psi> in the correct amplitudes?
basis: This is the paper's core technical contribution and the piece our replication does NOT cover — we only exercised the downstream QSVT-equivalent behaviour on the Hermitian reduction. A worked toy example of the history-state construction would give the community a canonical reproduction target and is the natural next step to move beyond a spot-check.
next_steps: Pick H = sigma_x (2x2, eigs +-1) as the minimal instance. Follow Theorem 1 of the paper to construct the block encoding of the padded I + L^2 - 2L*alpha*A operator. Solve the resulting quantum linear system classically (small dim). Verify amplitudes on the |j>|psi> basis match cos(j*arccos(H))|psi> to machine precision.
